query_lines: -- Alert: Credit Card Fraud Score Distribution Drift
-- Triggers when the population stability index of fraud probability exceeds 0.2,
-- indicating that the score distribution has shifted significantly from the
-- training baseline. Acts as an early warning signal that does not require
-- labels. Evaluated over a rolling 7-day window against the test baseline.
SUM(CASE WHEN prob_fraud < 0.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b0,
SUM(CASE WHEN prob_fraud >= 0.1 AND prob_fraud < 0.2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b1,
SUM(CASE WHEN prob_fraud >= 0.2 AND prob_fraud < 0.4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b2,
SUM(CASE WHEN prob_fraud >= 0.4 AND prob_fraud < 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b3,
SUM(CASE WHEN prob_fraud >= 0.6 AND prob_fraud < 0.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b4,
SUM(CASE WHEN prob_fraud >= 0.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b5
SUM(CASE WHEN prob_fraud < 0.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b0,
SUM(CASE WHEN prob_fraud >= 0.1 AND prob_fraud < 0.2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b1,
SUM(CASE WHEN prob_fraud >= 0.2 AND prob_fraud < 0.4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b2,
SUM(CASE WHEN prob_fraud >= 0.4 AND prob_fraud < 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b3,
SUM(CASE WHEN prob_fraud >= 0.6 AND prob_fraud < 0.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b4,
SUM(CASE WHEN prob_fraud >= 0.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b5
(c.b0 / c.n) AS c0, (b.b0 / b.n) AS b0,
(c.b1 / c.n) AS c1, (b.b1 / b.n) AS b1,
(c.b2 / c.n) AS c2, (b.b2 / b.n) AS b2,
(c.b3 / c.n) AS c3, (b.b3 / b.n) AS b3,
(c.b4 / c.n) AS c4, (b.b4 / b.n) AS b4,
(c.b5 / c.n) AS c5, (b.b5 / b.n) AS b5,
FROM current_window c CROSS JOIN baseline b
